introHtml: When you need a beer mug or stein that holds a full pint plus a little extra, 20 oz is the sweet spot. This size is ideal for serving hearty drafts at brewery events, corporate happy hours, or as a substantial giveaway that won't get tossed. The extra capacity compared to standard 16 oz mugs means your logo gets more face time with every pour. Choose from classic glass or durable ceramic options, and add your artwork with full-color imprint or etched designs for a premium feel.
